description: Adds various control panels to Minecraft which act as multiple buttons and levers in the same blocks. Has partial wireless support. All rights reserved (for now).

block: Can be used to compress levers and/or buttons in one single block.\nRight click with a lever or stone button to equipt it on that side. Names are allowed.

Links to a control panel to copy its signal on/off states to its sides.
Sneak right click on the panel while holding this to link.
Signal gets weaker the farther away from the panel.

Due to a bug, you must stand back to link.
This motherboard's network is full. The network maximum is %s.
This network now has %s motherboards. The network can get buggy and sync problems if it gets too big.

Used as a display version of a redstone comparator.
When not linked, it reads blocks and item frames just like a comparator.
Link it by right clicking it on a generic comparator.
When placed after the link was established, it's comparator gains a visual gauge to mark it is linked.
When linked, the gauge reads the comparator instead for it's display.
Only one gauge per comparator and vice versa.
The gauge gets it's reading locked if the comparator is broken, useful for decoration.
Unlike comparators and the gauge comparator, gauges do not output signal.
P.S. Gauges can float, why not.

Due to a bug, you must stand back to link.
item: Allows a control panel to be accessed farther away.\nNot compatible with mobile control panels.
No connection. Get closer to the block before trying again.
Not connected to a control panel.
The block cannot be found, The remote was reset.

releases.notes:
When control blocks are changed, they now sync data to all players around them. This can also cause the gui to update too.
Remotes work from 3x farther away. It is now a 144 block range from 48.
  -This only applies to old game directories if the config file option is deleted or changed.
Motherboards can now be harvested with a wooden pickaxe like the control blocks.
  -It previously was the only block in the mod to need a stone tool.
The control block gui now closes if the user moves out of range.
  -Range is calculated differently for the remote as opposed to direct access.
